title: Bhayya main aagayi hoon Nana
body:
Bhaiyya mai aa gayi hu
Chehlum ke liye bhaiya aayi hai teri Zainab, Ay mere bhai hussain x2
<<MINI>>
BHAIYYA MAI AAGAYI HUN, NANA KA DIN BACHA KE X2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaaungi ab madina chehlum tera manake
<<MINI>>
BHAIYYA MAI AAGAYI HUN, NANA KA DIN BACHA KE X2
<<DIVIDER>>
1)Maloom hai ye tumko zainab ujad chuki hai, Lekin teri shahadat ghar ghar pohonch gayi hai, Shabaash do behan ko x2 Bhaiya galay lagake
BHAIYYA MAI AAGAYI HUN… 2)Bhaiya tumhari zainab ab wo nahi rahi hai, Pehchaan loge mujhko haalat badal gayi hai, Chalti hai ye zaeefa x2 bhaiyya kamar jhuka ke
BHAIYYA MAI AAGAYI HUN… 3)Sajjad aur baaqir denge gawahi meri, Khaye hai taaziyane binte ali ne phir bhi, Le aayi shamiyon se x2 waaris tere bacha ke
BHAIYYA MAI AAGAYI HUN… 4)Kaise bataun bhaiya bazaar me jo guzri, Kehte the sab ke maaro ye hai ali ki beti, Baba ke bhi mai badle x2 sab aayi hoo chuka ke
<<DIVIDER>>
BHAIYYA MAI AAGAYI HUN… 6)Ghar ja ke kya karoongi pehlu may hi sulaalo, Akbar se kehke mujhko turbat ki jaa dilaado, Maalik ho tum to bhai x2 jageere karbala ke
BHAIYYA MAI AAGAYI HUN… 7)Ye kehke ay ‘Takallum’ uthi ali ki beti, Abbas ki lahad par pohoncha de mujhko koi, Dikhla dun ba-wafa ko x2 rassi ke neel jaake
BHAIYYA MAI AAGAYI HUN…
